meta.title: Tapro Gems | Natural Sri Lankan Gemstones
meta.description: Tapro Gems is a Finland-based, family-owned gemstone house offering hand-selected, certified natural Sri Lankan sapphires, rubies and rare gemstones for collectors, investors and jewellery designers across Europe.

hero.imageAlt: Model wearing a Tapro Gems sapphire necklace, earrings and ring
hero.paragraph: Hand-selected, certified natural gemstones from Sri Lanka, presented with European trust.

brandIntro.text: Two generations of expertise, dedicated to bringing the finest natural gemstones from Sri Lanka to discerning collectors across Europe.

why.imageAlt: Woman wearing a Tapro Gems sapphire pendant necklace and earrings
why.text: Every gemstone we offer is hand-selected at origin in Sri Lanka and independently certified — a standard upheld by three generations of family ownership.

occasion.imageAlt: Woman wearing a Tapro Gems sapphire drop earring
occasion.text: one exceptional stone, set to accompany every chapter of your life — from boardroom to gala.

banner.imageAlt: Hand holding a natural sapphire gemstone
banner.text: Each stone is hand-selected for its rarity, clarity, and light — brilliance that speaks for itself.

story.title: The Tapro Story
story.quote: “Every gemstone carries the story of the earth it was formed in — we simply help it find the hands it belongs to.”
story.imageAlt1: Raw sapphire crystal in its natural rock matrix
story.imageAlt2: Two hands cupped together holding a polished sapphire

collectors.imageAlt: Woman holding a loose natural sapphire
collectors.ringAlt: Gold ring set with a natural sapphire
collectors.title: Collectors & Professionals
collectors.description: Private sourcing, wholesale parcels and consultation for collectors, investors and jewellery designers who require a trusted, direct relationship with origin.

certification.title: Certification & Authenticity
certification.description: Every gemstone is offered with clear provenance. Sri Lankan gem authority certification is standard, with international certificates such as GIA available on request.

certificates.title: Sri Lankan Gem Authority
certificates.description: Local gemmological certification recognised at origin.

certificates.title: International Certification
certificates.description: GIA and other international certificates arranged on request.

appointment.title: From Raw Earth to Rare Beauty.
appointment.imageAlt: Natural sapphires and a ruby resting on ivory satin fabric

founder.title: Three generations, one origin.
founder.description: Tapro Gems began with a family connection to the gem fields of Ratnapura, Sri Lanka. Today, that relationship allows us to hand-select stones directly at origin — passing the same trust and care on to every client we serve, from Helsinki to across Europe.
